sources.snippet: CrossModal Deepfake Detection (Audio + Video Fusion) This project implements a crossmodal deepfake classifier that jointly processes audio and video to detect manipulated media with high reliability. Built on the FakeAVCeleb dataset, the model fuses audio and visual features and is benchmarked against single-modality baselines.
